mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.7% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a 3-month window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100), manufacturing sector weakness signals reduced corporate capital expenditure and lower earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000 monthly additions) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the labor market fuels economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), monetary tightening reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds from reduced demand and output.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
